options.meaning: A festival volunteer documents the first usable lantern after rain damaged the workshop stock. Newly stitched translucent paper beside crumpled ruined sections gives a quiet reason for relief.
options.material: rice paper, bamboo ribs, blue cotton repair thread
options.shutter_moment: one hand supports the repaired lantern while the other makes a mirror self-portrait

options.meaning: A backstage maker records a repaired stage moon minutes before a reopened performance. The patched crease remains visible as evidence of work rather than concealed perfection.
options.material: silver papier-mache, cotton tape, painted timber
options.shutter_moment: one hand holds the restored crescent at waist height while the other makes a mirror self-portrait

options.meaning: A textile repairer compares a rain-stained scarf with its first successful new color, recording an unexpectedly useful accident. The rescued cloth changes the subject from concern into restrained delight.
options.place: narrow textile dye room after rain
options.material: silk, dye-stained porcelain, brass drying rods
options.shutter_moment: one hand lifts the dried scarf before the mirror while the other makes a self-portrait

options.meaning: A radio volunteer records a recovered tape reel after an interruption. A freed loop and the carefully coiled usable reel make patience and repair visible.
options.material: magnetic tape, aluminum reels, felt work mat
options.shutter_moment: one hand holds a recovered reel on its rigid hub while the other records a mirror self-portrait

source_scope: general knowledge and independent visual reasoning
capture_choice_ownership: agent_authorial; physical mirror portrait is arm assignment, not requester camera lock
